row.notes: Deletes every file in a save directory: logs 'Empty directory requested for %s', FindFirstFile/FindNextFile over the folder, DeleteFile each (maps device-removed / corrupt / access-denied to Ne errors via Ne_SaveError_* helpers), logs 'Empty directory result: 0x%x' and returns the Ne error code. Callers: Ne_SaveSystem_DeleteDirectory 0x14413ad6d, Ne_SaveSystem2Win_Mount copy-files step 0x144147c9e. Addon: tells which save folder files are wiped before a save is rewritten (backup before this runs).

verify.notes: V2565 Empty directory requested/result strings, FindFirst/Next, DeleteFile error strings
